title: Property copy reuse loses destination capacity and text ownership
summary: indigo_libs/indigo_bus.c:1618-1635, public contract indigo/indigo_bus.h:667, live cache reuse indigo_filter.c:1006. Reused destination grows only to active source count, then header memcpy overwrites its allocated_count with source reserve capacity. Release and later reuse trust a capacity the destination may not own. Old destination long_text allocations are overwritten without freeing. Fix capacity-preserving deep assignment and release previous text ownership. Existing copy test exercises NULL destination only. Root independently confirmed. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (CORE-1). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
